top_signals.title: Russian Crude Exports Drop to Lowest Since May
top_signals.summary: Russia’s seaborne crude exports fell to their lowest level since May as recovering refinery runs pulled barrels back into domestic processing and attacks disrupted loading at key ports. Russia shipped 3.71 million barrels per day in the four weeks through August 9, according to vessel-tracking data compiled by Bloomberg. Shipments averaged just 3.25 million bpd in the latest week, down from 3.5 million bpd a week earlier. The drop comes just days after industry sources said Russian crude and condensate production rose by roughly 100,000 bpd…

top_signals.title: Apollo Inks $2.6 Billion Financing Deal With NY Yankees
top_signals.summary:
Apollo Global Management Inc. is providing $2.6 billion of financing to the owners of the New York Yankees, the private capital giant’s largest investment to date in US sports.
Bloomberg Sports Reporter Randall Williams joins to break down the deal, and what it means for the Yankees and future sports financing. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: SEC Weighs Direct Funding for Costly Market-Tracking Database
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is considering taking direct control of a controversial database that tracks trades across US equities and options markets after Citadel Securities won a lawsuit challenging its funding last year.

top_signals.title: A Solar Eclipse Will Flip the Off Switch on Europe’s Solar Farms
top_signals.summary: Night will fall on Europe’s power system a bit early Wednesday evening, as an eclipse is set to block solar generation across parts of the UK and western Europe.

top_signals.title: Radiant World Offers $150 Million Aluminum Stash for Sale
top_signals.summary: Metals trader Radiant World has been seeking to sell a stockpile of aluminum worth some $150 million at a small discount to market prices in an attempt to boost its liquidity, according to people familiar with the matter.
